title: FAQ: Can I see Stacko before committing?
caption:
"Can I see Stacko before committing?" Yes: start with a meeting.

We'll show you the live map, the invoice drafts and the approvals on examples like yours. Bring a real supplier invoice and watch the draft it becomes. Then we agree on a clear plan and a quote for your locations, users and setup.

Book a meeting with our team. Link in bio.
